_note: THE WORDS of the animals' list of pages, English. Each listed page stands with its name and line from the registry.

meta.title: Animals | Museum of Ages
meta.description: How big animals of the past were, each beside a person 1.70 m tall to one scale, in the museum's own pictures. The first page is megalodon.

top.answer: The museum is building a wing of animals that lived long ago. Until it opens, each page here says how big one of them was, beside a person, in our own pictures.

out.text: Museum of Ages is a digital museum. Open today is the Leonardo da Vinci wing.
